result.reason: The clause provides the preferred six-month transition period at then-current rates and includes deletion certification, but it does not require data return within 30 days of expiration or termination. Return is contingent on a Customer request and due 30 days after that request, which could be much later. It is also overbroad on termination of a single Service Option Attachment because it requires return and deletion of all Customer data, including data potentially used under continuing attachments. The language should tie the 30-day export deadline to the effective termination date and, for partial termination, limit return and deletion to data associated with the terminated services.
